evidence.quote: Bruno Doutrelepont, Founder Born in Belgium and having lived in the London, Milan and Monaco previously, with a stint in the New York, Bruno is now a long term resident of Greystones, Ireland. Originally from a family involved in Architecture and Construction, he has over 30 years’ experience in family office management, investments, real estate and private equity. He has worked in leadership positions (including Head of Wealth Management) with the likes of JP Morgan, Barclays and BNP Paribas. Bruno spent a considerable amount of time developing family office best practice with like-minded international single (SFO) and multi (MFO) family offices, before setting up Even Keel Family Office.
